videos.title: Koajs Quickstart Guide
videos.description:
In the last Episode I talked about JavaScript generators(http://knowthen.com/episode-2-understanding-javascript-generators/), and how they can make your developer life a little more pleasant.  This week I am giving you a quickstart tutorial on using Koajs the first web framework built from the ground up using generators.

Please join my mailing list so I can let you know when new screencasts are released -  http://knowthen.com/join/
